import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
import subprocess,sys
L='/home/mj-kang/Documents/Dev/math/openai-proof-research/frontier/campaigns/2026-10-27/new-discoveries-batch2/new-twenty-2026-10-31/expanded-corpus-r530/'
t=open(L+'PROPOSALS.md',encoding='utf-8').read()
old="""Also proved here: for ANY admissible F with kernel orthonormal matrix G, kernel vectors give sigma_min(F_S)<=sqrt k sigma_min(G_T), so
the supremum of tau is within a factor sqrt k of the Parseval quantity."""
new="""Also proved here: for any rank-n admissible F whose kernel has orthonormal-row matrix G, a unit a attaining sigma=sigma_min(G_T)
gives c=G^T a in ker F, and F_S c_S=-F_T c_T yields sigma_min(F_S)<=sqrt k * sigma/sqrt(1-sigma^2) when sigma<1. So the

assert t.count(old)==1
t=t.replace(old,new)
r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',L+'write_lane.py','PROPOSALS.md'],input=t,text=True,capture_output=True)
